transcript: Dots versus Muse versus Grok Bot. I've been using them all and here is the difference. ChatGPT's Dots is like your personal assistant. It has an email of its own, it connects with apps, highlights what's happening in your mail, and preps you up for your day. Muse is also a personal assistant, but with access to Meta and its platforms. So, I can ask Muse to reply to my comments, it can research and find viral reel ideas, content formats, and I can even audit my account apart from just being a general-purpose agent to shop for me, do other errands on my behalf. And then, there's Grok Bot. Now, Grok Bot is interesting because here, you can create AI employees. It's like having like a team, like a WhatsApp chat with all my little Grok Bots doing things for me. Then, I can add them all into one group and make them talk to each other. Grok Bot is available for $20 per month Cursor plan. Muse is available for free, but not for everyone yet. And Dots is available in the $100 per month ChatGPT plan. So essentially, Dots is for your personal work, Muse is for all your Instagram data, and Grok Bot is for setting up a team of AI agents. Which one is your personal favorite? Let me know below and
